subject: Follow‑up: Enterprise Workflow Automation Tender Win
html:
We confirmed that we won the enterprise workflow automation tender we submitted last month. This win means we will begin onboarding conversations next week, and it’s important because it brings a new client into our ecosystem. The team highlighted that a smooth transition will be critical for client satisfaction.

Priya, please prepare the onboarding materials for the tender client by Friday so we can share them ahead of the kickoff. Rohan, please assign an internal point of contact for the new account by the end of the week so the delivery team has a clear liaison. Once these tasks are done, we’ll schedule a handoff meeting for the following Monday to ensure everyone is aligned.

Sent by Swytchcode Aurora
